scripts.prisma:generate:safe: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$pids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($pids) { $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; npx prisma generate --schema prisma/prismaModels.prisma"
